## How I tested it

- [ ] `node --run test` passes
- [ ] `node --run lint`, `node --run format:check` and `node --run typecheck` are clean
- [ ] A behavior change has a test and a line in the docs
- [ ] A change to the shim says which adapter versions I tried
- [ ] No transcripts, tokens or real thread content in tests or docs
